meta.name: cortex-integrate
meta.description: Design and implement an AI feature integration — model selection, architecture pattern, system prompt, data flow, error handling, cost estimate. Use when asked to "add AI to this", "LLM integration", "add Claude/GPT", or "AI-powered feature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速为现有应用设计和接入AI功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在产品里加入对话、生成或分析等AI能力
copy.tagline_en: Design and integrate AI features into existing apps quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add conversational, generative, or analytical AI to your product

howto.what: 当用户要求为应用添加 AI 功能时，Claude 会自动扫描代码库，通过决策树选择最佳集成模式（提示工程、RAG、工具调用、智能体循环或微调），设计系统提示、数据流、错误处理与成本控制，并生成实现代码及测试评估。
howto.when: 当你要求“给这个加 AI”、“编辑现有代码实现 LLM 集成”、“在项目中接入 Claude 或 GPT”或提及“AI 特性”时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个页面加一个 AI 建议功能。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码并设计提示调用方案。

say.text: 把现有的搜索功能替换成 RAG 方式。
say.note: Claude 会搭建嵌入、检索、生成管道。

say.text: 在项目中接入 Claude API，实现智能客服。
say.note: Claude 会生成客户端、提示模板和错误处理。

howto.what_en: When asked to add AI to an app, Claude scans the codebase, picks the best integration pattern (prompt, RAG, tool use, agentic loop, or fine-tuning) via a decision tree, then designs system prompts, data flow, error handling, cost controls, and produces implementation code with evaluations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say things like "add AI to this", "LLM integration", "add Claude/GPT", or "AI-powered feature". Also activates on concrete requests for AI feature implementation.

say_en.text: Add an AI suggestion feature to this page.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze code and design a prompt-based solution.

say_en.text: Replace the current search with a RAG approach.
say_en.note: Claude will build embedding, retrieval, and generation pipeline.

say_en.text: Integrate Claude API for an intelligent chatbot.
say_en.note: Claude will generate client, prompt templates, and error handling.
